hypotheses.justification: Deleting hN keeps the statement true and provable; only the degenerate case N = 0 has to be handled, and it holds by Mathlib's junk-value convention for Subgroup.index. Subgroup.index H = Nat.card (G ⧸ H) (Mathlib/GroupTheory/Index.lean:55) returns 0 when the index is infinite (Nat.card_eq_zero_of_infinite, Mathlib/SetTheory/Cardinal/Finite.lean:66). At N = 0 the level-zero congruence is equality: Gamma0 0 = {A ∈ SL(2,ℤ) : A 1 0 = 0}, since (a : ZMod 0) = 0 ↔ (0:ℤ) ∣ a ↔ a = 0 by ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd (Mathlib/Data/ZMod/Basic.lean:513, stated for every modulus b, 0 included). Also N.primeFactors = (N.factorization).support (Nat.support_factorization, rfl) and Nat.factorization_zero : factorization 0 = 0, so 0.primeFactors = ∅ and both big products are empty products = 1; the statement at N = 0 thus reads (Gamma0 0).index = 0. This holds because [SL₂(ℤ) : Γ₀(0)] is infinite: the cosets of T^j * S are pairwise distinct, since ((T^j * S)⁻¹ * (T^i * S)) 1 0 = j - i (this entry computation is already available in this very file as the private lemma rep_diff_10, proven from TjS_inv_mul_10), and this element lies in Γ₀(0) iff j - i = 0. Proof without hN: rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos N; for 0 < N rerun the existing proof verbatim with hN := hN.ne'; for N = 0 show (Gamma0 0).index = 0 by unfolding Subgroup.index, proving the map fun j : ℤ ↦ QuotientGroup.mk (T^j * S) into SL(2,ℤ) ⧸ Gamma0 0 injective (QuotientGroup.eq + Gamma0_mem + ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd — the same pattern as Gamma0_prime_index_inj at lines 561–576 of this file), then Set.infinite_range_of_injective (Mathlib/Data/Set/Finite/Basic.lean:912, with the Infinite ℤ instance) makes Set.range f infinite, Set.Infinite.to_type (same file, line 842) gives Infinite of the coset space, and Nat.card_eq_zero_of_infinite gives index = 0; both sides then reduce to 0 = 0 via the empty primeFactors products. This is a short elementary argument (~15 lines) reusing entry lemmas already in this file; the current proof's uses of hN (Gamma0_index_eq_prod_factorization hN and Nat.prod_factorization_pow_eq_self hN) are only needed on the 0 < N branch.
